node.statement: Direct source application of GT-lee-2ed-thm-21.10-corrected: Lee, Theorem 21.10, states that if a Lie group G acts smoothly, freely, and properly on a smooth manifold M, then the orbit space M/G is a topological manifold of dimension dim M - dim G and has a unique smooth structure for which the quotient map pi:M->M/G is a smooth submersion. This is exactly the assertion of node 1; the external preserves the source text byte-for-byte, while M=G, the OCR control glyph between dim M and dim G, and the OCR control glyph before W M ! M=G are respectively the extraction encodings of M/G, the printed minus sign, and pi:M->M/G.
